input.reasoning:
Estimated using story points as a proxy for relative effort (1 point ≈ 6-7 hours of blended engineering effort, adjusted per task type), then split hours across roles based on task nature (backend-heavy, frontend-heavy, QA, DevOps/infra, migration). Total backlog = 81 points across 8 tasks.

Role allocation logic:
- PW-1 (CI/staging, 5 pts): DevOps-led with Backend support.
- PW-2 (design system, 8 pts): Frontend-led with QA pass.
- PW-3 (registration/login, 8 pts, Urgent): Backend-led, Frontend for UI, QA for security/flows.
- PW-4 (RBAC, 13 pts, High): Backend-heavy with Frontend enforcement and QA.
- PW-5 (dashboard, 8 pts): Frontend-led with Backend API support and QA.
- PW-6 (invoice list/detail, 5 pts): Frontend + Backend (PDF gen) + QA.
- PW-7 (Stripe integration, 13 pts, Urgent): Backend-heavy (webhooks/reconciliation), QA critical, DevOps for infra/secrets.
- PW-8 (data migration, 21 pts, High): Backend-heavy (ETL scripts), DevOps for environment/cutover, QA for validation.

Capacity check: Backend Developer 1.5 FTE ≈ 60 hrs/week available; Frontend 1.0 FTE ≈ 40 hrs/week; QA 0.6 FTE ≈ 24 hrs/week; DevOps 0.4 FTE ≈ 16 hrs/week. Total allocated hours below are within a ~10-12 week delivery window per role capacity, though QA and DevOps are thin relative to backlog breadth (flagged in assumptions).

Non-labour costs added for Stripe sandbox/fees setup, staging cloud infra, and a legacy data migration contingency (tooling/read-replica costs) since 400k+2M record migration often needs temporary infra beyond dev hours.

Reductions identified: descope PW-2 design system polish (defer theming tokens), reduce QA depth on PW-6 (lower priority), and defer legacy migration scope (partial migration/phasing) as biggest lever given it's 21 points and High (not Urgent) priority.

nonLabourLines.description: Staging/CI cloud infrastructure setup and monthly hosting during build (est. 3 months)
Stripe integration sandbox testing, webhook tooling, and PCI review support
Legacy Oracle migration tooling / temporary read-replica and ETL environment
Contingency for third-party PDF generation and email delivery service setup

assumptions: No historical actuals (real spend data) are available for this project yet; estimate is based on story points and task decomposition only, not past velocity.
1 story point ≈ 6-7 hours of blended engineering effort, adjusted by task complexity and role mix.
Backend Developer at 1.5 FTE (~60 hrs/week) is the primary constraint; 760 hours implies roughly 12-13 weeks of backend capacity fully dedicated to this backlog.

QA Engineer (0.6 FTE, ~24 hrs/week) and DevOps Engineer (0.4 FTE, ~16 hrs/week) are thinly staffed relative to the breadth of the backlog (8 tasks including a large migration and a payment integration); both roles are a scheduling risk and may extend timeline or require overtime/backfill.
Legacy data migration (PW-8, 21 points) is treated as the single largest cost driver and assumes no schema documentation gaps requiring extensive discovery beyond current backend hours.
Payment provider integration (PW-7) assumes use of standard Stripe Checkout/Elements APIs rather than a fully custom payment UI, keeping frontend hours moderate.
Non-labour costs are rough order-of-magnitude estimates for cloud/tooling spend and are separate from labour; actual vendor pricing not yet confirmed with Northwind Ltd.
Estimate assumes a single delivery team with no parallel workstreams beyond the natural role split, i.e. no additional contractor surge capacity.

reductions.description: Defer full legacy data migration scope (PW-8) to a phased approach: migrate active/recent customer records and invoices first, archive the rest for a later phase.
reductions.effect: Reduces Backend and DevOps hours on PW-8 by roughly 40%, pushing remainder to a future project phase.

reductions.description: Descope advanced theming tokens and dialog variants from the design system (PW-2), delivering a minimal component set now and expanding post-launch.
reductions.effect: Cuts Frontend Developer hours on PW-2 by ~80 hours.

reductions.description: Reduce QA depth on lower-priority Invoice list/detail view (PW-6) to smoke testing only, relying on developer self-testing for edge cases.
reductions.effect: Cuts QA Engineer hours on PW-6 by 40 hours.

reductions.description: Defer dedicated staging environment cost hardening (e.g. multi-region, autoscaling) until post-MVP; use a single low-cost staging instance for now.
reductions.effect: Reduces non-labour infrastructure line item for staging/CI.
